name: Yenching Academy of Peking University (Yenching Scholars)
funding: Every admitted scholar gets a fellowship covering tuition, campus housing, a monthly stipend, medical insurance, one round trip to Beijing and research costs, for a two-year master's in China Studies.
deadline: 2027 cohort: Nov 30, 2026, 9:00 am Beijing time (students at partner universities go through their university's pre-selection first)
